articles.title: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
articles.description: A man, a woman and a teenage girl die, and a younger girl is in critical condition, after swimming off Shoreham on the Sussex coast.

articles.title: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
articles.description: Rough sleepers in England will be offered housing, in a move likened to the “Everyone In” initiative during the pandemic.

articles.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
articles.description: Martial law has been in place in Ukraine since February 2022, under which elections are suspended.

articles.title: Demand for degree apprenticeships in England quadruples in three years
articles.description: The popularity of degree apprenticeships has grown as the cost of university has come under increased scrutiny.
